hotspots.title: US Midterm Election Rout & MAGA Internal Backlash
hotspots.blurb: The fallout from the Republican Party's heavy losses in the US midterm elections continues to dominate right-wing media landscape. Internal party finger-pointing has intensified, with Vice President JD Vance blaming the administration's intervention in Iran while lawmakers like Thomas Massie move to impeach War Secretary Pete Hegseth. Reports of Secretary of State Marco Rubio contemplating resignation highlight growing destabilization within MAGA leadership.
hotspots.affect: The unexpected election losses have triggered widespread anxiety and aggressive blame-shifting across MAGA media, turning internal administration disputes into a high-stakes public conflict.

hotspots.title: Polish Constitutional Court Crisis & Coup Accusations
hotspots.blurb: The standoff surrounding Poland's Constitutional Tribunal (TK) has reached a fever pitch as Law and Justice (PiS) leader Jarosław Kaczyński announced a parliamentary team to investigate what he labels an unconstitutional coup d'état. Tensions escalated further as President Karol Nawrocki forced entry into the Tribunal building accompanied by State Protection Service officers, while PiS launched a no-confidence motion against Interior Minister Marcin Kierwiński.
hotspots.affect: The acute legal and institutional standoff is amplified by rhetoric invoking illegal coups and potential life imprisonment, charging the debate with intense existential outrage.

hotspots.title: Flávio Bolsonaro Defeat & Brazil Election Fraud Claims
hotspots.blurb: Following his election loss, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro generated widespread debate by admitting in an interview that he lacks concrete proof of election fraud, while continuing to challenge the legitimacy of the results. His high-profile appearance at a Mar-a-Lago CPAC event alongside US allies coincides with legal actions taken against him by Brazil's Superior Electoral Court (TSE) and parliamentary maneuvers to preserve his Senate mandate.
hotspots.affect: The combination of lingering election denialism, legal pressure, and international posturing maintains high affective investment among Bolsonarista channels.

hotspots.title: Javier Milei Madrid Visit & Vox Alliance
hotspots.blurb: Argentine President Javier Milei stirred international controversy during his trip to Spain for the Ibero-American Summit by explicitly equating socialism with fascism in his plenary address. His cold handshake with Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez contrasted sharply with his enthusiastic bilateral meeting with Vox leader Santiago Abascal, cementing his role as a global figurehead for the right.
hotspots.affect: Milei's provocative rhetoric and direct ideological confrontation with European left-wing leaders provoke passionate reactions of triumph among supporters and intense outrage among critics.

hotspots.title: Marine Le Pen Launches RN Campaign & Congress
hotspots.blurb: Rassemblement National leaders Marine Le Pen and Jordan Bardella have stepped up their ideological offensive ahead of the upcoming presidential cycle. Bardella aggressively attacked La France Insoumise for 'totalitarian' tendencies over proposals targeting conservative broadcaster CNews, while Le Pen strongly rejected proposed minimum wage increases as reminiscent of Soviet-style economics.
hotspots.affect: RN's framing of policy disputes as civilizational clashes against totalitarianism creates a strong moral charge aimed at rallying conservative voters.
